source_text: Mittitur ad fratres in Sichem, invenit in Dothain. Venite, occidamus somniatorem.
pass_a_gloss: Is-sent to brothers in Shechem, finds in Dothan. Come, let-us-kill the-dreamer.
pass_b_english: [[Sent to the brothers at Shechem, found at Dothan >> Bible:Genesis 37:12-17]]. [[Come, let us kill the dreamer >> Bible:Genesis 37:19-20]].
